gpt.text:
Run the three “Next Commands” in order; they’re already the correct continuation from this handoff.

## 1) Run AUB autopilot (module-level search, pick best)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
What this does:
- Trains/evaluates the module candidates listed in `module_registry.yaml`
- Compares them against the current champion (`baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`)
- If a candidate beats the champion under the tool’s selection criteria, it will be selected/promoted (depending on your autopilot settings).

After it finishes, check the produced report/logs for:
- Whether a new champion was selected
- The delta vs current `tuning_mean/min` and `lockbox_mean/min` (you generally want improvements on lockbox, not just tuning)

## 2) Run system autopilot (system-level candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
What this does:
- Evaluates end-to-end system variants described in `system_candidates.yaml`
- Useful when module-level wins don’t translate to lockbox gains, or when interactions between modules matter.

Look for:
- Any system candidate improving **lockbox_mean** and not regressing **lockbox_min** materially
- Overfitting signs: tuning improves but lockbox degrades

## 3) Generate “next fix” plan (actionable patch suggestions)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
This should produce a markdown plan in `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` with:
- The most promising failure modes to target next
- Which module(s) to adjust and why
- Concrete follow-up experiments to run

---

If you paste the outputs (or the key summary sections) from steps 1–2, I can help decide whether to accept a new champion, whether the gains are real (lockbox vs tuning), and which fixes from `next_fix.md` are worth prioritizing.
